$comment: What is true of each translation rather than of any line inside it.
Neither the endonym nor the licence can be derived from a catalogue, and
build-locales-index.mjs refuses to publish a language that has no entry
here — so a translation cannot reach the app with nobody having recorded
what it may be used under.
`endonym` is the language's name for itself: Suomi, not Finnish. Somebody
opening the language list may be a person who cannot read the language
currently on their screen, which makes a list of English names useless to
exactly the people who need it.
`licence` is MIT, matching the app it translates. Unlike catalog/, which
is CC0 because a list of feed URLs is a table of facts, a translation is
somebody's writing and is theirs to licence. MIT is what a contribution to
an MIT application is; a translator who wants different terms may say so
here, and `credit` names them if they want naming.
